description: Machine format (wr.telemetry.v1, testnet): every sealed compile envelope for one metric id, oldest first. Use telemetry_latest instead when you only need the newest envelope per metric. Points are ordered oldest first by as_of. An unknown metric id is not an error — it returns count 0 and empty points; call telemetry_latest with metric omitted to enumerate the valid metric ids. stale says whether this metric is in the store's stale_flags. Returns {format, metric, count, points, stale}; if the store file is absent on this deployment, empty points with a note instead. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication; every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, query, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).

metric.description: Metric id, as enumerated by telemetry_latest (call it with metric omitted to list all metric ids).
